name: Mosquito Patches (24N)
subtitle: Stick. Press. Repeat

benefits.title: Protect
benefits.description: Sticking these mosquito patches to your kid's bag or clothes, make sure your kid stays protected from mosquito.

benefits.title: Repels
benefits.description: Scent of Citronella Oil and Lemongrass Oil repels mosquitoes, letting you stay itch-free

benefits.title: 100% Safe
benefits.description: Each patch is 100% toxin and DEET-Free making them safe for your kid.

description: ►Mosquito-free evenings for your kids►Without the worry of smelly balms or liquids►Stick this patch to create a protective layer around your kid►Enriched with Citronella and Lemongrass oil, it repels mosquitos►Zero toxins and DEET-free►Let your kid have all the fun without any itchy bumps

Step 1:Peel the patch and apply it on the child's clothing, bag, socks, or nearby surface.

Step 2: Gently press the patch to make it stick.

Step 3:Once your kid is back, remove it by gently losing one side of the sticker and peeling slowly.

howToUse:
Step 1:Peel the patch and apply it on the child's clothing, bag, socks, or nearby surface.

Step 2: Gently press the patch to make it stick.

Step 3:Once your kid is back, remove it by gently losing one side of the sticker and peeling slowly.

faqs.question: Can I apply this after applying a cream?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can top off this patch post any-kind of cream application.

faqs.question: Do I need to use this in monsoons?
faqs.answer: You can use this all around the year.

faqs.question: Can adults use these patches?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is safe to use for all.

reviews.author: Sneha Parekh
reviews.title: Highly recommended for Summers
reviews.body: Kids want to play outside with so many mosqitos in summer. It is incredibly gentle and doesn't cause any harm. Kids love the smell too.

reviews.author: Reena Jain
reviews.title: Amazing product
reviews.body: I allow my kid to now play in the evening without any worry! My kid also likes to show off different pics on patches everyday!

reviews.author: Kena Verma
reviews.title: SO CUTEE and COLOURFUL
reviews.body: These are SOO CUTE and colourful. Love the fact that I can just leave this on and not worry about mosquitos.
